'''Tatsuki Kōbe''' (Japanese: '''光部樹''' ''Kōbe Tatsuki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

Kōbe is a Japanese voice actor. He joined the Pokémon animated series during {{aniseries|JN}}, voicing a number of minor characters and several of [[Goh]]'s Pokémon. Kōbe's most notable role to date is that of [[Iris's Haxorus]].
